payload.model_patch:
diff --git a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py
index 477aae247..16eb2d0b6 100644
--- a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py
+++ b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py
@@ -231,6 +231,12 @@ def get_object_members(subject: Any, objpath: List[str], attrgetter: Callable,
             name = unmangle(cls, name)
             if name and name not in members:
                 members[name] = Attribute(name, i == 0, INSTANCEATTR)
+            elif name and name in members:
+                # If the member is already defined, but it's an annotation-only
+                # member from a parent class, mark it as not directly defined
+                # unless it's from the current class
+                if i > 0 and members[name].directly_defined:
+                    members[name] = Attribute(name, False, members[name].value)
 
     if analyzer:
         # append instance attributes (cf. self.attr1) if analyzer knows
@@ -299,6 +305,13 @@ def get_class_members(subject: Any, objpath: List[str], attrgetter: Callable
                 name = unmangle(cls, name)
                 if name and name not in members:
                     members[name] = ObjectMember(name, INSTANCEATTR, class_=cls)
+                elif name and name in members:
+                    # If the member is already defined, but it's an annotation-only
+                    # member from a parent class, update its class_ to the parent
+                    if cls is not subject and members[name].class_ is subject:
+                        members[name] = ObjectMember(name, members[name].object,
+                                                     class_=cls,
+                                                     docstring=members[name].docstring)
 
             # append instance attributes (cf. self.attr1) if analyzer knows
             try:
